title: Dylan Gedig: Perfect Synergy: How Roguelike Developers and Streamers Form the Perfect Ecosystem
speaker: Dylan Gedig
talk_title: Perfect Synergy: How Roguelike Developers and Streamers Form the Perfect Ecosystem
description:
Peglin's Early Access release was a massive success, almost entirely due to the incredible streamers and YouTubers that focus on Roguelike games. This talk will be a focused post-mortem on how our relationships with streamers were the cornerstone to Peglin's success, how Roguelike developers and Roguelike streamers have formed the perfect conditions to work together as a healthy industry, and what developers can do to better work with streamers for their own roguelike games.

Lead-in music generated by Sonat Uzun.
